name: Santa Cruz de Marchena (Spain)
description: Green field with a yellow cross throughout, cantoned by four white orange-blossom flowers.
history: The flag of Santa Cruz de Marchena is described as a rectangular flag-green cloth of 1:1.5 crossed by a yellow cross whose arms are one sixth of the width, cantoned by four orange-blossom flowers; the arms were approved by the municipal council on 20 June 2002 and entered in the Andalusian register of symbols (BOJA no. 130 of 7 November 2002).

features.role: cross with arms one sixth of the width
orange blossoms in the four cantons
